name: hcb-dev
description: Personal developer baseline — a connected pipeline from a task or an issue to reviewed, completed work: slicing and building behind one planning gate, local review in one round with every source — Claude's angles, security angles and a Codex pass — its findings checked by an independent verifier and each source's coverage reported, completion by mode (a local merge into the parent, or a change request), the forge's issue tracker and its label set, handing work across sessions, surveying a backlog slice against the code, fanning an epic out to parallel sessions in waves, saying where the work stands in whichever role a session holds, keeping a branch current with a base that moved and reading what it brought, and git cleanup.
